extension.description: Browse and play audiobooks and podcasts from your AudioBookShelf server.
extension.news: v0.22.0 Browsing is about five times faster: the root menu went from 0.91 s to 0.18 s and Authors from 1.08 s to 0.09 s. requests is replaced by a standard-library HTTP client (its import alone cost 0.5-1.2 s on every folder you opened), interpreter reuse is enabled, the pointless token-check round trip per listing is gone, and the progress map and API client are cached between invocations.
